items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And Cat Anderson said -- the way Cat described it, he said

ctx.x: That's as far as it went, though, he just picked him up and let him dangle. He didn't hit him or anything.

No, no, he didn't hit him. He just picked him up, like a wall -- like he didn't hold him up, he balanced him up beside of a wall, you know. And there was another time, I think they were rehearsing, and Duke was very concerned about this arrangement, and I guess everybody knows how Cat Anderson and Cootie Williams did not get along. But they were rehearsing where there was a stack of empty ashtrays close to Duke, and Cootie was -- I don't know, he was in one of those moods where he didn't feel like playing what…
